name: speech.cpp Local Speech Presets
description: MIT local speech runtime (OpenAI-compatible audio API on 127.0.0.1). Install with `pnpm tool:setup -- --tool speech_cpp --apply`. Start `speech serve [models...] --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8095`. Batch TTS/ASR prefer the CLI; HTTP is for voice-hub / OpenAI clients.

speech.description: OpenAI-compatible TTS; JSON body with input and voice
